purpose: Deploy our support code to an already installed Codex server. Do not reinstall Codex or replace authentication.

windows.note: Preserve settings, token, certificates and GUI ownership. Update only while bridge-owned jobs are idle.

linux.transport: SSH runs codex-rpc @stdio; native daemon persists between connections.
linux.note: Helper update does not restart the daemon, replay commands or modify existing Codex configuration/authentication.

register.note: Register host, protocol and private credential file references, then preserve the conversation when restarting evo-bot. Root changes still require owner approval.
